summary: First full-stack test of KShopping. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering health, public product list/detail/404, JWT auth (login success/wrong creds/me/invalid token), admin product CRUD (create/update/delete with persistence GET verification), and 401/403 protection. Frontend: homepage with hero + 3 product cards renders; product landing page (slug) shows CTA + price + benefits + reviews; admin login flow works (wrong creds shows toast, correct creds navigates to /admin); admin dashboard lists products in table; protected route redirects when unauthenticated; product create/edit/delete and logout work — BUT the 'Made with Emergent' badge (id=emergent-badge) at fixed bottom-right intercepts pointer events on the AdminDashboard drawer's sticky 'Salvează' (save-product-btn) button, blocking a real user from saving new/edited products. After removing the badge in JS the entire CRUD flow worked. force=True click in Playwright did NOT bypass it.

minor.issue: slugify() in server.py strips underscores BEFORE converting whitespace to dash, so 'TEST_Produs Automat' becomes 'testprodus-automat-xxxxx' instead of 'test-produs-automat-xxxxx'. Fix: replace underscores with space (or dash) before the [^a-z0-9\s-] strip, or include underscore in the allowed set.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed 'Made with Emergent' badge (a#emergent-badge, bottom-right) overlays the sticky drawer footer's Salvează button at approx the same coords and intercepts pointer events. Real users cannot click Save. Reproduced consistently in Chromium 1920x1080. Workaround that proves it: removing #emergent-badge via JS makes save click work and product is created/edited via /api/admin/products successfully.

issues: Sticky footer with Save button does not account for the bottom-right Emergent badge overlay; consider moving footer Save to bottom-left, increasing right padding, or giving drawer a higher z-index combined with positioning the action buttons away from the badge area.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix AdminDashboard product drawer Save button overlap with #emergent-badge. Options: (a) anchor drawer footer Save button to the left or center, (b) increase pr-* on the footer flex container so Save sits left of the badge, (c) ensure drawer's z-index is above the badge AND set pointer-events on the drawer footer correctly so even when stacked, the badge is below. The badge is rendered globally and cannot be moved, so the Admin UI must reserve bottom-right space.
Minor: Update slugify() to replace underscores with space/dash before stripping non-alpha chars (so 'TEST_Foo' → 'test-foo' instead of 'testfoo').
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET is required from env (good) but token expiry is 12h with no refresh endpoint — acceptable for MVP admin.
CORS is permissive (allow_origins from env defaulting to '*', allow_credentials=False). For production tighten to the actual frontend origin.
seed_admin updates password if it doesn't match (good, idempotent) but there is no admin lockout / brute force protection on /api/auth/login. Acceptable for MVP.
All admin endpoints depend on get_current_admin which checks role=='admin' — good.
MongoDB _id is excluded everywhere ({_id: 0} projection) — good.
Frontend api.js axios should also handle 401 → auto logout (token expiry). Currently a 401 only shows generic toast 'Eroare la încărcare'.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 demo products + admin user on startup. Test pollution from prior runs (TEST_Produs Automat) was cleaned up at end of testing — final state: exactly 3 demo products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. Run backend tests with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_kshopping.py. The blocking issue is the Emergent badge intercepting the drawer Save button click in AdminDashboard.jsx. Once main agent fixes the layout (e.g. shifts Save button left or raises drawer z-index/positioning), re-run Playwright on the Add Product / Edit Product flow without force=True and without removing the badge — that's the regression check.
rca of the issue:
ROOT CAUSE: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx the drawer (lines 195-269) renders a sticky footer at bottom-right (justify-end) with the Salvează button. The global #emergent-badge element (injected at app root by the Emergent platform) is fixed at bottom-right and has a higher stacking context than the drawer's z-50 footer. Playwright reported: '

Made with Emergent

from subtree intercepts pointer events'. REPRODUCTION: 1) Login as admin, 2) Click 'Adaugă produs', 3) Fill form, 4) Click 'Salvează' — nothing happens. MITIGATION: Move the Save button away from bottom-right corner (e.g. justify-between with Save on left, or add right-margin > 200px), OR raise the drawer container's positioning so its footer isn't at viewport bottom-right (e.g. pb-20 inside drawer + footer relative).
